title: Go to Stacks Murder Scene

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I was told this might be another Aseptic crime scene?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was told this might be another Aseptic crime scene?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I was told this might be another Aseptic crime scene?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I was told this might be another Aseptic crime scene?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: It's a little suspicious, you always turning up around the body-bags. Who did you say you're working for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a little suspicious, you always turning up around the body-bags. Who did you say you're working for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's classified.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's classified.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Must have been. I don't know why they bother calling me out to these. Place was cleaner than a Corpsters alibi during a data breach.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Must have been. I don't know why they bother calling me out to these. Place was cleaner than a Corpsters alibi during a data breach.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You must have a good reputation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must have a good reputation.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You must have a good reputation.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You must have a good reputation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah seems like your job is a waste of time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah seems like your job is a waste of time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah seems like your job is a waste of time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah seems like your job is a waste of time.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I... thank you. That's kind. Sorry I get a little carried away with the CorpSec hate...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... thank you. That's kind. Sorry I get a little carried away with the CorpSec hate...

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Well it would be if CorpSec weren't so incompetent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well it would be if CorpSec weren't so incompetent.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did they miss something else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did they miss something else?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Look, I probably shouldn't have trusted you last time either. Just go back to running that noodle stand. Why get in over your head?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I probably shouldn't have trusted you last time either. Just go back to running that noodle stand. Why get in over your head?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't really have a choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't really have a choice.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't really have a choice.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't really have a choice.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Whatever vigilante shit you’ve got going on, I hope you’re serious about catching this guy. I got into a lot of debt, trading BitBucks and I'm worried I'm going to be high on his list. Such a sick fucking MO. Targeting the poorest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever vigilante shit you’ve got going on, I hope you’re serious about catching this guy. I got into a lot of debt, trading BitBucks and I'm worried I'm going to be high on his list. Such a sick fucking MO. Targeting the poorest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry to hear about the BitBucks? What are BitBucks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry to hear about the BitBucks? What are BitBucks?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry to hear about the BitBucks? What are BitBucks?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry to hear about the BitBucks? What are BitBucks?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The corps aren't all bad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The corps aren't all bad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah agreed, death to the Corpsters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah agreed, death to the Corpsters.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah agreed, death to the Corpsters.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah agreed, death to the Corpsters.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You know how Lims are a recognised and tested form of digital bartering with a widely accepted value? Well the opposite of that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know how Lims are a recognised and tested form of digital bartering with a widely accepted value? Well the opposite of that.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text:
Here's what CorpSec missed. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub" Found it in the poor fucks jacket.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Here's what CorpSec missed. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub" Found it in the poor fucks jacket.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text:
Whatever you say kid. Here's what CorpSec missed. Seems like some kind of weird data-log the guy had in his pocket. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub" Found it in the poor fucks jacket.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Whatever you say kid. Here's what CorpSec missed. Seems like some kind of weird data-log the guy had in his pocket. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub" Found it in the poor fucks jacket.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I actually don't know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I actually don't know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Somebody hacked my phone and threatened me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Somebody hacked my phone and threatened me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Somebody hacked my phone and threatened me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Somebody hacked my phone and threatened me.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Sounds like corporate power throwing its weight around to me. You should watch your back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like corporate power throwing its weight around to me. You should watch your back.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You're sounding more like a Corpster every time I see you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're sounding more like a Corpster every time I see you.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Well it sounds like you need to start doing some digging. Nothing more dangerous than a puppet master. Except for a serial killer maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well it sounds like you need to start doing some digging. Nothing more dangerous than a puppet master. Except for a serial killer maybe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, Aseptic was here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, Aseptic was here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll stick to Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll stick to Lims.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text:
Here's what CorpSec missed. Seems like some kind of weird data-log the guy had in his pocket. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub". Found it in the poor fucks jacket.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Here's what CorpSec missed. Seems like some kind of weird data-log the guy had in his pocket. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub". Found it in the poor fucks jacket.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why give it to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why give it to me?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Because, I already checked it and it's a completely garbled mess. Any chance I could have sold it, certainly wouldn't be giving it to you! Plus I gotta get to a crime scene where a man murdered his wife with her own cat. Should be a fun one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because, I already checked it and it's a completely garbled mess. Any chance I could have sold it, certainly wouldn't be giving it to you! Plus I gotta get to a crime scene where a man murdered his wife with her own cat. Should be a fun one.
